parent_objective: design the HF0 high-fidelity interface boundary after M2471 pivots away from direct current-sim static materialization
blocked_by: high-fidelity validation cannot start until the backend boundary observation/action parity and claim boundary are specified
current-sim should remain a diagnostic layer rather than the only validation layer
actor input contract must be preserved before any high-fidelity smoke or rollout
supersedes: direct high-fidelity rollout without interface design
direct current-sim materialization chain as the only next route
high-fidelity migration that changes the deployed actor input or action contract

public_gates: M2472 must design only the HF0 high-fidelity interface boundary
M2472 must preserve the P0 human-view actor input contract and actuator-level action output
M2472 must define reset step time actuator latency state extraction failure taxonomy and artifact boundaries
M2472 must state how labels hidden dynamics oracle values and high-fidelity internal states remain outside actor input
M2472 must route to an implementation or parity-smoke milestone without high-fidelity rollout verdict claims
M2472 must not train rank controllers select winners or make paper self-ID finite-window-vs-GRU current-sim or high-fidelity validation claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run current-sim reset or rollout
do not change the deployed action contract
do not inject hidden or oracle actor features
do not claim high-fidelity validation readiness
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: designs the high-fidelity backend interface boundary after M2471 pivot without executing simulation or changing actor contracts
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: HF0 design only; no high-fidelity run, current-sim run, policy action, training, ranking, winner selection, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, or validation verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if the interface requires hidden or oracle actor inputs
stop if the interface changes the deployed action contract
stop if the interface cannot preserve observation shape and value-range parity checks
stop if the next route would run validation before an implementation/parity smoke
fallback_plan: route to HF0 implementation if the boundary is narrow and actor-contract preserving
route to interface repair if state extraction or action mapping is ambiguous
stop for user review if high-fidelity backend choice requires a contract change
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2471 pivot selected high-fidelity interface preparation as the next branch

admission_evidence: M2471 route synthesis pivots away from direct static current-sim materialization
post-M2470 route plan defines HF0 interface design as the first high-fidelity stage
paper-route plans require high-fidelity as validation layer while preserving the P0 actor contract
allowed_updates: M2472 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the design
next_stage_criteria: P0 observation extractor mapping and action mapping requirements are specified
failure taxonomy and artifact boundaries are specified
a bounded implementation or parity-smoke route is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2472 designs an interface and does not test history necessity or current-frame substitution.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2472; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2471 route synthesis and governing paper-route plans.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If HF0 cannot preserve the actor contract, classify it as interface readiness failure rather than driver or self-ID failure.
allowed_claims: no high-fidelity validation result, controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: opens a new high-fidelity interface preparation branch rather than adding another current-sim static artifact
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can prepare validation infrastructure but cannot itself establish paper or high-fidelity evidence
must_synthesize_if: HF0 cannot preserve the actor input contract
HF0 cannot define a bounded implementation or parity-smoke route
three further high-fidelity interface milestones remain design-only without executable smoke evidence

hypothesis: A narrow HF0 interface design can prepare high-fidelity validation while preserving the current deployable actor input and actuator-level action contracts.
success_criteria: the design specifies DynamicsBackend reset step and time contracts
the design specifies P0 observation extraction and steer throttle brake action mapping boundaries
the design specifies failure taxonomy artifact boundaries and claim boundaries
a bounded implementation or parity-smoke follow-up route is selected
no high-fidelity run current-sim run training ranking winner or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2472 executes simulation reset rollout policy action replay PPO or training
M2472 changes actor input or action contract
M2472 injects hidden or oracle actor features
M2472 ranks controller families or selects a winner
M2472 claims high-fidelity validation paper finite-window-vs-GRU or self-ID result

commands.name: design
commands.command: write docs/m2472-high-fidelity-interface-hf0-design.md from M2471 synthesis and route plans

decision_rule: M2472 passes if it writes a bounded HF0 interface design that preserves actor/action contracts and selects an implementation or parity-smoke route without simulation, training, ranking, or verdict claims.
